name: Judge
overview: Scripture instructs that judges must be God-fearing, truthful, and just leaders appointed to bear the burden of governing the people, as seen in Exodus 18 where capable men are chosen to judge lesser matters to ease the burden on Moses. Judges are called to administer righteousness without partiality, treating both the poor and the mighty fairly, as emphasized in Leviticus 19. Their role includes resolving disputes fairly, such as in property cases, and maintaining respect for God's authority and earthly rulers, underscoring the divine order established for governance and justice.
